description.fun: The Pokémon world's lucky cat: the gold koban coin on Meowth's forehead comes from Japan's beckoning maneki-neko. It can't resist anything round and shiny, and prowls city streets at night picking up dropped change. Meowth is the only Pokémon with regional forms from two different regions, and the only one with both a regional form and a Gigantamax form.
description.guide: A nocturnal cat Pokémon modelled on Japan's maneki-neko, with a gold koban coin set in its forehead. Meowth is drawn to round, shiny objects and picks up loose change on city streets at night. It has regional forms in both Alola and Galar.
description.tagline: The lucky cat that can't walk past a shiny coin.

names.ja: アローラ ニャース

description.fun: Brought to Alola as a gift for royalty, Meowth grew used to luxury and turned proud, picky and Dark-type, with blue-grey fur. When the monarchy fell, the pampered cats went feral.
Years with a seafaring, Viking-like people turned parts of its body to iron. Its shaggy beard keeps out the cold, and its coin is black: the darker and harder the coin, the more respect it earns.
Stretches into a very, very long cat. The symbol on its giant coin is thought to be the key to the secrets of Dynamax.

names.th: เปอร์เซียน

description.fun: Persian is admired for its elegance and prized by the rich, but it's notoriously hard to keep as a pet: fickle and temperamental, it will scratch anyone, its Trainer included, with little or no reason. Strangely, tugging its whiskers makes it docile. It walks without a sound, and the jewel on its forehead makes it a target for hunters.
description.guide: The evolution of Meowth, a sleek, cat-like Normal Pokémon with a red jewel on its forehead. It is graceful and popular with the wealthy, but fickle and quick to scratch. Its Alolan form is a Dark type with a round face and blue-grey fur.
description.tagline: An elegant cat with a jewel, a temper and no time for you

names.ja: アローラ ペルシアン

description.fun: A life of luxury under Alola's old monarchy gave its Persian a big, round face and blue-grey fur softer than velvet, and the plumper the face, the more beautiful it's thought to be. Proud and haughty, it opens a battle with a refined act, then fights dirty.

names.th: กาลาร์ เนียคิง

description.fun: Only Galarian Meowth become Perrserker: its hair has hardened into a horned Viking helmet with its coin set in front, and its claws can join into daggers. It lives for the thrill of battle, and many epic tales praise its valour. Less heroically, it leaves rubbish all over its home, and it and Persian can't stand each other.
description.guide: A Steel Pokémon introduced in Generation 8 that evolves only from Galarian Meowth. Its head hair has hardened into a horned, helmet-like shape, and its claws form daggers. It is fierce and loves to battle.
description.tagline: A Viking cat that lives to fight and never tidies up

note.text: Only Galarian Meowth can become Perrserker: many battles gave it the ability to evolve into Perrserker instead of Persian.
